protocol.universe: All 505 TQBR stocks in data/candles/moex_scan/universe_2026-10-30.json; 1H/4H only where hourly candles exist
protocol.trend_small: confirmed weekly 5/5 pivot, alternating ZigZag swings at least 2 weekly ATR14 apart, line through two same-type pivots, at least 2 touches within 0.5 weekly ATR, no closing break >0.5 ATR, extension <=2x base length
protocol.trend_large: same, weekly 25/25 pivot and 5 weekly ATR14 swing
protocol.volume_profile_proxy: rolling 26 or 52 completed weeks; allocate each daily candle's share volume uniformly to 48 bins spanning its high-low; POC is largest bin, VAH/VAL expand to 70% volume from POC
protocol.confluence: trendline and corresponding VAH/VAL must be within 2 signal ATR14
protocol.entry: first rejection of weekly support/resistance within 0.5 signal ATR14 on completed signal bar, fill next bar open; long at support, short at resistance
protocol.exit: opposite EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch closes any position; a new level signal may reverse it
protocol.control: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch both sides on same bars, capital, execution, and costs
protocol.selection: research ranking only; no numeric approval threshold and no automatic strategy or paper deployment
limitations: Not the proprietary TradingView Auto Trendlines implementation
Daily OHLCV volume allocation is not traded volume at price
Exchange lots, dividends, short borrow and corporate actions are omitted
protocol.baseline: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch both sides on same bars, capital, execution, and costs

signal_rule.entry: first rejection of weekly support/resistance within 0.5 signal ATR14 on completed signal bar, fill next bar open; long at support, short at resistance
signal_rule.exit: opposite EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch closes any position; a new level signal may reverse it
